requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features and scan workflow solutions, along with manageability tools specifically designed for SMBs with minimal IT support. This includes AI-powered print and scan, and an SMB portal for managing devices.
requirements.Rationale: Target SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient productivity and management tools due to lack of dedicated IT resources. Differentiates HP’s offering from competitors.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: SMB Portal development, AI solutions integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI print and scan features are functional and accessible through SMB portal; SMB portal is user-friendly and supports device management tasks for SMBs; All features tested and validated in real SMB scenarios.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Magellan must deliver the lowest business TCO in HP’s SMB portfolio, achieved through high-yield ink tanks, minimal maintenance, and efficient consumables usage.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMB customers; critical to compete and capture market share.
requirements.Dependencies: High-yield ink tank design, maintenance-free engineering
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis confirms Magellan’s TCO is lower than all other HP SMB printers; Comparative TCO data available for sales enablement.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by end customers, targeting minimal intervention and reduced service costs. If not customer replaceable, ensure service center replacement is simple (MINK at service centre).
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack IT staff; reducing downtime and service calls is essential for this segment.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customer can replace maintenance box with no tools and minimal instructions; Service center replacement process is under 10 minutes if required; Documented and validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement uniquely keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and reduce support/service issues.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes user errors, supports warranty claims, and reduces potential for printer damage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All ink bottles are uniquely keyed and cannot be inserted in the wrong tank; Field tests confirm zero cross-contamination events.

requirements.Title: PDL and Non-PDL SKUs with Distinct Features
requirements.Description: Offer both PDL and non-PDL SKUs. PDL SKU must support 25/20 ppm speed, PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification. Non-PDL SKU must support SMB 2.0 solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses diverse SMB needs and regulatory requirements in different markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs available at launch; PDL SKU meets speed and certification requirements; Non-PDL SKU fully supports SMB solutions and PaaS.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Printer must be designed with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding major competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and priority for target SMBs; enhances HP’s brand position.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and supplier certifications confirm 60% RCP in plastic components; Marketing claims substantiated with third-party verification.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMB customers to manage all their HP devices, including printers, with features for monitoring, configuration, support, and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs need simple, centralized management tools to reduce IT burden.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, Device integration APIs
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports device addition, monitoring, configuration, and support for all SMB printers; Usability testing with target SMBs shows high satisfaction; Analytics features operational.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80,000 Pages or 2 Years (Whichever First)
requirements.Description: Standard product warranty must cover either 80,000 printed pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides clear value proposition and aligns with SMB usage patterns and expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published in all sales and support materials; Internal systems and support teams aligned.

requirements.Title: Telemetry and Remote Monitoring
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features to enable remote monitoring, diagnostics, and proactive support for Magellan devices.
requirements.Rationale: Enables better support, reduces downtime, and provides actionable insights for HP and customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data can be securely transmitted and visualized in the SMB portal; Support teams can access remote diagnostics; Compliance with privacy regulations.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support PaaS offerings, enabling subscription-based printing services for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic goals for recurring revenue and meets evolving customer preferences.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan can be enrolled and managed in HP’s PaaS platform; Subscription workflows tested and validated.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Implement advanced AI-driven print and scan quality optimization features branded as 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan'.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers superior user experience and differentiates HP from competitors in the SMB segment.
requirements.Dependencies: AI algorithm development, Device firmware integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features demonstrably improve print and scan output in independent testing; Features are accessible via device UI and SMB portal.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities using the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a top priority for SMBs and supports modern workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices via HP App; Functionality validated with iOS and Android devices.
